visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width image (e.g. a map) with absolutely positioned circular hotspots that open a Dynamic Media video or Scene7 viewer in a modal
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width Iceland map image with 6 positioned hotspot circles opening DM videos / 3D viewer | Full-width map image with absolutely positioned circular hotspots opening video popups

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background image (single cell: picture, image link or bare URL); then one row per hotspot: cell 1 = media URL (DM delivery /play URL or Scene7 viewer URL), cell 2 = left position in % (e.g. 38.5%), cell 3 = top position in % (e.g. 39%), optional cell 4 = accessible label
contentPattern.description: Interactive component (clickable hotspots open media); no library block covers it, custom block required

usage: Interactive map or scene where points open videos or 3D/spin viewers.
reuseGuidance: Reuse whenever media should open from points on an image. Rows missing a URL or a valid position are skipped.
